title: CoverStory Days 99–112 restart-safe local delivery
outcome: Restart-safe local delivery of committed ISSUED events via event-log-backed durable-work materialization and explicitly invoked bounded command.
constraints: No Kafka, Redis, scheduler, automatic retries, leases, new HTTP route, cloud resource, credentials, or real customer data.
Receipt and acknowledgment are separate commits; no exactly-once/global-order claim.
